description.title: הגדרות נוספות
description.summary: This table defines terms related to Computer Fraud and Computer Systems as they apply to insurance coverage. It clarifies what constitutes a covered loss in the context of electronic data and communication.
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מגדירה מונחים הקשורים להונאת מחשב ומערכות מחשב, כפי שהם חלים על כיסוי ביטוחי. ההגדרות מתייחסות להונאה הקשורה לקלט, שינוי או הרס של תוכניות או נתונים אלקטרוניים, וכן להעברת הוראות העברת כספים קולית. פוליסת ביטוח אחריות מקצועית ליועצי השקעות כוללת הרחבה לכיסוי הפסד של צד שלישי שנגרם ישירות על ידי הונאת מחשב שבוצעה על ידי אדם שאינו עובד. מונחים מרכזיים כוללים הונאת מחשב, מערכת מחשב, העברת כספים קולית, ורשתות תקשורת פתוחות.
notable_values: Computer Fraud: fraudulent input, modification or destruction of computer programs
Computer System: computer suitable for multi-use applications
Electronic Communication System: communication transmitted through an Electronic Communication System

sketch:
IMPORTANT NOTICE:
It  is  expressly  understood  and  agreed  that  coverage  according to this part shall be in force and valid only if completed and signed Proposal Form has been submitted to the Insurer and the Insurer has agreed and confirmed in writing to the Assured that this part is valid and in force.
This policy is extended to include:
Third  party  loss  directly  caused  by Computer  Fraud committed  by  any  person  except  an employee.
Additional Definitions:
Computer Fraud means the fraudulent input, modification or destruction of computer programs; or  the  fraudulent  input,  modification  or  destruction  of  electronic  data  within  the Assured's Computer  Systems ;  or  the  fraudulent  transmission  or  modification  of  a  communication transmitted through an Electronic Communication System ; or the fraudulent transmission of a voice  initiated  funds  transfer  instruction  directly  to  the Assured over  the  telephone  by  an unauthorized person.
Computer  System means  a  computer  suitable  for  multi-use  applications  that  is  capable  of directing  hardware,  software  and  data  resources  according  to  computer  programs  formulated and  introduced  to  the  computer's  operating  system  by  the  user  including  private  branch exchange,  voice  mail  processor,  automated  call  attendant  or  telephone  routing.    All  input, output,  processing,  storage  and  communication  facilities  including  related  communication  or open systems networks which are physically connected to such a devise, as well as the device's off-line media libraries, are deemed to be part of said computer said.

טבלה: הגדרות נוספות
This table defines terms related to Computer Fraud and Computer Systems as they apply to insurance coverage. It clarifies what constitutes a covered loss in the context of electronic data and communication.
ממדים: Definition, Description

IMPORTANT NOTICE:
It  is  expressly  understood  and  agreed  that  coverage  according to this part shall be in force and valid only if completed and signed Proposal Form has been submitted to the Insurer and the Insurer has agreed and confirmed in writing to the Assured that this part is valid and in force.
This policy is extended to include:
Third  party  loss  directly  caused  by Computer  Fraud committed  by  any  person  except  an employee.
Additional Definitions:
Computer Fraud means the fraudulent input, modification or destruction of computer programs; or  the  fraudulent  input,  modification  or  destruction  of  electronic  data  within  the Assured's Computer  Systems ;  or  the  fraudulent  transmission  or  modification  of  a  communication transmitted through an Electronic Communication System ; or the fraudulent transmission of a voice  initiated  funds  transfer  instruction  directly  to  the Assured over  the  telephone  by  an unauthorized person.
Computer  System means  a  computer  suitable  for  multi-use  applications  that  is  capable  of directing  hardware,  software  and  data  resources  according  to  computer  programs  formulated and  introduced  to  the  computer's  operating  system  by  the  user  including  private  branch exchange,  voice  mail  processor,  automated  call  attendant  or  telephone  routing.    All  input, output,  processing,  storage  and  communication  facilities  including  related  communication  or open systems networks which are physically connected to such a devise, as well as the device's off-line media libraries, are deemed to be part of said computer said.
